party_a.name: TechFlow Solutions Inc.

party_b.name: Global Enterprises LLC

recitals: TechFlow is engaged in the business of providing enterprise software solutions and professional services related thereto
Client desires to engage TechFlow to provide certain professional services as described in Exhibit A attached hereto
TechFlow desires to provide such services to Client pursuant to the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement

clauses.title: Services
clauses.content: TechFlow agrees to perform the professional services described in Exhibit A (the "Services") in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. TechFlow shall perform the Services in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.
subclauses: TechFlow shall assign qualified personnel to perform the Services and shall have the right to substitute personnel of equivalent qualifications upon notice to Client.
TechFlow shall use commercially reasonable efforts to meet any milestones or deadlines specified in Exhibit A, provided that Client fulfills its obligations hereunder in a timely manner.
Any changes to the scope of Services shall be documented in a written change order signed by both Parties.

clauses.title: Compensation
clauses.content: In consideration for the Services, Client shall pay TechFlow the fees set forth in Exhibit B attached hereto. All fees are exclusive of taxes, which shall be the responsibility of Client.
subclauses: TechFlow shall invoice Client monthly for Services performed during the preceding month. All invoices are due and payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.
Late payments shall accrue interest at the rate of one and one-half percent (1.5%) per month or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is less.
Client shall reimburse TechFlow for all reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred in connection with the Services, provided such expenses are pre-approved by Client in writing.

clauses.title: Intellectual Property
clauses.content: Each Party retains all right, title, and interest in and to its pre-existing intellectual property. All intellectual property created by TechFlow specifically for Client in the course of performing the Services ("Work Product") shall be owned by Client upon full payment of all amounts due under this Agreement.
subclauses: TechFlow retains the right to use any general knowledge, skills, experience, and know-how acquired in the course of performing the Services.
TechFlow may retain a copy of all Work Product for archival and portfolio purposes, subject to confidentiality obligations.
Client grants TechFlow a limited license to use Client's trademarks and logos solely for the purpose of identifying Client as a customer of TechFlow.

clauses.title: Representations and Warranties
clauses.content: Each Party represents and warrants that it has the full right, power, and authority to enter into this Agreement and to perform its obligations hereunder.
subclauses: TechFlow represents and warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional manner consistent with industry standards.
TechFlow represents and warrants that to its knowledge, the Work Product will not infringe upon any third party intellectual property rights.
EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH HEREIN, TECHFLOW MAKES NO WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

clauses.title: Indemnification
clauses.content: Each Party shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other Party and its officers, directors, employees, and agents from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to the indemnifying Party's breach of this Agreement or negligent acts or omissions.

liability_cap: the total fees paid by Client to TechFlow under this Agreement during the twelve (12) months preceding the claim
dispute_resolution: binding arbitration in San Francisco, California in accordance with the Commercial Arbitration Rules of the American Arbitration Association
